hero.title: Halal shopping, with clear, Shariah-compliant monthly instalments.
hero.body: Agree the full sale price with the merchant upfront, then pay in clear monthly installments. See every due date before you accept. No interest is added to your installments.
hero.note: Agreed total price · clear dates · no interest added

sections.how: Know the total. See every payment date.
sections.howBody: Review the merchant’s fixed total price, installment amounts and due dates before you decide.
sections.why: No surprises from checkout to final payment
sections.whyBody: Your offer shows the agreed price and schedule up front. Customer installments do not grow with interest.
sections.pricingBody: A transparent platform fee for the tools you use. Never added to a customer's installments.
sections.final: Make every installment easy to follow.

customerSteps.threeBody: Use the payment details in your plan and keep the schedule and receipts handy.

content.merchantTitle: A workspace made for everyday collections
content.merchantBody: Keep customer records, fixed-price plans, payments and reminders together — while the merchant stays in control.
content.faqIntro: A few useful details for merchants and customers.
content.feeDetails: Choose a flat fee per active plan or a percentage of plan value. Your exact fee will be shown before you activate your merchant account.
content.noCustomerFees: No fees added to customer installments
content.freePlan: No charge for customers to view their plan
content.fixedClearBody: The total deferred price is agreed upfront and the schedule is visible before acceptance.
content.paidToMerchantBody: Customers pay the merchant directly. Amanah Pay does not hold or pool customer funds.
content.merchantPaidBody: A transparent platform fee is charged to the merchant, never added to the customer plan.
content.dataBody: We aim to collect only what is needed to manage and track the plan.
content.reviewRequired: Product structure and any religious or regulatory claims require independent review before launch.
content.customerRecordsBody: Find a plan and payment history quickly.
content.scheduleBody: Keep every due date and balance visible.
content.remindersBody: Share a reminder by WhatsApp or SMS.
content.merchantControlBody: Your team decides how to offer a plan.
content.upiBody: Show the merchant’s own payment details.
content.reportsBody: See collected, pending and overdue amounts.
content.aboutBody: Amanah Pay is being built to make installment agreements easier for merchants to share and easier for customers to understand.
content.contactBody: Tell us a little about your business and what you need.
content.replyEmail: We’ll reply to your email as soon as we can.
content.messagePlaceholder: A short note about your business
content.moreDetail: Please add a little more detail.
content.demoContact: Demo form · messages are not sent until the contact API is connected.
content.faqDates: Can the customer see every due date?
content.faqLate: Does the app add late fees?
content.faqDirectBody: The customer pays the merchant directly using the merchant’s UPI details or a gateway that settles to the merchant.
content.faqScheduleBody: Yes. The customer offer page shows the agreed total, down payment and complete schedule before acceptance.
content.faqLateBody: Late-fee terms are optional, off by default, and must be disclosed in the agreement before acceptance.
content.faqDataBody: Only the information needed to create and service the merchant’s plan should be collected.

legal.placeholder: This page is a draft placeholder for legal review. It is not the final contract or privacy notice.
legal.serviceBody: Amanah Pay helps merchants create and track fixed-price installment schedules. Customer payments are made directly to the merchant. The platform does not hold or pool customer funds.
legal.customerBody: Information should be collected only for clear purposes, protected with appropriate safeguards, and retained only as required. Contact support for requests about your information.
legal.grievanceDraft: A designated grievance contact and response timelines will be added before launch.
